name: SDF Growth Refinement
definition: A strategy to refine an optimized Signed Distance Function (SDF) for better reconstruction of thin objects by guiding SDF growth from spatial points where missing thin segments meet the surface, utilizing 2D image information.
summary: SDF Growth Refinement is a post-training optimization that improves thin object reconstruction by using error-guided sampling to iteratively grow the SDF from identified error-prone areas.
